page.layout: No printed text on this scan. The scan shows the outside of a limp vellum binding (the cover of the book, not a printed page), with stains and stitching holes. The digitiser's scale bar, the library label and the DFG/HAB banner are not printed text.
page.notes: This scan shows the vellum wrapper of the book, not a printed page. It has no printed words, so nothing is transcribed. Visible: a grey scale strip and a Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel label, both digitiser or library material and left out. Vellum stains, a few small holes and the sewing thongs at the spine edge are damage, not text.
